zh.intro: 美感不一定能直接打動市場；我沈浸在產品與使用者之間的曖昧，理解人、需求與背後的商業目的，讓設計成就真正的價值。透過這樣的思維，讓我的設計歷程從視覺、電商，逐步延伸到產品體驗。
zh.pathVisual: 從品牌與視覺設計出發，建立對美感、資訊傳達與品牌一致性的敏感度。
zh.pathBusiness: 在電商品牌的實務中，學習理解消費者需求、規劃資訊路徑，將美感轉化為有效的商業溝通。
zh.pathProduct: 隨著設計環境持續改變，我開始進修產品設計，並發現它與過去的經驗緊密相連，同樣需要理解使用者、梳理資訊與設計流暢的體驗。於是，我將累積的視覺、行銷與商業理解，延伸到流程、介面與產品體驗設計。
zh.valuesLead: 三個陪我走到現在的核心價值，它們也成為我做設計時最重要的依據。
zh.v1: 好的設計始於理解脈絡。梳理情境、角色、流程與條件，建立完整而清晰的訊息。
zh.v2: 把複雜的問題理順。透過架構、流程與系統化思考，將打結的部分轉化成清晰、好理解的資訊。
zh.v3: 設計最美的時刻，是自然地被使用，不被察覺，在理想與限制之間協調。既能落地，同時默默創造價值。
zh.softLead: 這些特質讓我在團隊中，能成為可靠、穩定輸出且值得信任的夥伴。
zh.s1: 在逆境中穩定前進，將挑戰轉化為成長動能。
zh.s2: 從商務、使用者與技術視角，彈性轉化思路。
zh.s3: 持續吸收新觀點與技術，並轉化為產品判斷。
zh.stubResume: 履歷 PDF 準備中，敬請期待

en.intro: Aesthetics alone don't always move the market. I immerse myself in the ambiguity between product and user — understanding people, their needs, and the business goals behind them, so design can create real value. This mindset has carried my design journey from visual and e-commerce work into product experience.
en.pathVisual: Starting from brand and visual design, I built a sharp sense for aesthetics, information delivery, and brand consistency.
en.pathBusiness: Through hands-on e-commerce brand work, I learned to understand consumer needs, plan information paths, and turn aesthetics into effective business communication.
en.pathProduct: As the design landscape kept evolving, I began studying product design — and found it deeply connected to what came before: understanding users, structuring information, and crafting fluent experiences. So I extended my accumulated visual, marketing, and business understanding into flows, interfaces, and product experience design.
en.valuesLead: Three core values that have carried me this far — and remain my most important compass in design.
en.v1: Good design starts with understanding context. By mapping scenarios, roles, flows, and constraints, I build a complete and clear picture.
en.v2: Making complex problems make sense. Through structure, flows, and systems thinking, I turn the tangled parts into clear, understandable information.
en.v3: Design is at its best when it's used naturally, without being noticed — balancing ideals and constraints, grounded in reality while quietly creating value.
en.softLead: These qualities make me a reliable, consistent, and trusted partner on any team.
en.s1: Moving steadily through adversity, turning challenges into momentum for growth.
en.s2: Shifting flexibly between business, user, and technical perspectives.
en.s3: Continuously absorbing new perspectives and technologies, and turning them into product judgment.
